svg.text: Classification engine: observable states (same page, four situations)
Rows already classified do not change position; the others show “…”.
Classified 50 loaded notifications · other pages not loaded
Counts are not the account total. Load more notifications to extend them.
Native reason only · direct vs. team request cannot be verified
No token for “northwind”: its notifications stay “Unverifiable”.
GitHub rate limit reached · retrying at 14:32
Already classified notifications stay; the others are “Unverifiable”. None is hidden.
“Native inbox” immediately restores the identical GitHub page, with the same filters and search. The engine is read-only: no notification is marked as read, archived or hidden.
A notification is “Needs attention” only with evidence; when in doubt it is “Unverifiable”. Mockup with entirely fictional data.
